scope: Offline only; no production changes, game launch, native build, new sampling, or extra acceptance pairs.

audit.limit: Historical launcher hashes of final prepared files plus source/runtime flags and fresh process. Not independent in-process attestation of every loaded script. In-memory reconstruction reproduces git-show bytes and Windows write_text CRLF; initial archive-only comparison mismatched newline serialization and was corrected before final assertion.

resident_paths.change: Existing globally connected _compiled_configuration_event adds a six-string membership check for every event; epoch increments only on matching configuration events. Not a per-step numeric-template scan.
Existing on_simulation_event adds upgrade equality check for every routed event; geometry_matches and turret rebind loop run on upgrade only. All six runs have6447 routed calls and48 upgrades.

turret_pose now writes current entry each call; previous identity comparison removed. Ordinary aim/pose readers can reach it. turret_angle also removes identity comparison. No isolated timing/count of turret_pose.

weapon_multiplier delegates unchanged identity search/binding to a helper and checks empty Dictionary; adds call overhead to ordinary timed-stat queries. Existing numerical cache rebuild may move to later consumers after purchase.
resident_paths.measured_cost: unknown; prior numeric-update B3 slowdown predates this helper, so helper is not a necessary explanation for that repeated pattern

resident_paths.change: Numeric epoch validation/template freeze occurs on admission/configuration/purchase; no added scan in advance/prepare_geometry. invalidate_stat_cache and native_before_configuration_change also update epoch when invoked.

observations: Logic count240, prepare_geometry240, before/after_tick240, routed geometry events6447, damage-display calls6520 and final kernel counters identical across six runs. Display calls follow rendered frame count; no measured call-count explosion.
B3 ordinary quarters17.165/21.708/21.151/16.641ms; A3 17.987/16.193/16.304/16.592ms. Slowdown concentrated in middle, not monotonic accumulation.

B3 first two boundary frames contain2 logic steps each (cross60 at61; cross120 at120); final two contain1 each. Boundary root CPU3.919/3.225/2.868/2.675ms, ship CPU1.249/.958/.830/.784ms. These observations explain unequal work per boundary, not the cause of slowdown.
Ordinary frames with exactly1 logic step still average17.877ms B3 versus16.710ms A3. More multi-step frames do not fully account for the regression.

A3/B3 full-window process CPU3984.375/3953.125ms while frame counts233/208. Fixed240-step windows cannot attribute ordinary-frame CPU from total CPU; fewer render frames can offset extra CPU per frame.

Current ordinary A3/B3 root CPU2.646/2.896ms, ship CPU.815/.872ms; GPU root.422/.470ms, ship2.666/.319ms. Viewport counters do not form a complete elapsed-frame decomposition or prove GPU/wait cause. Ship GPU differs sharply across runs (B1 also~.327); retain raw counter values without assigning cause.

Previous B3 ordinary quarters17.076/18.839/19.047/17.184ms also slow in middle. Both B3 are last in identical order, but A/B was not counterbalanced across last position. Order association, candidate behavior, scheduling and logical-phase interaction remain confounded; no background/compile attribution established.
missing: Per-frame actual CPU execution (prefer main-thread CPU plus process CPU) aligned with ordinary-frame wall spans of game/main callbacks and rendering submission/wait. Existing acceptance phases arrays are empty and ProcessTimes covers only the whole window.
proposed_minimum_next: If parent authorizes, one diagnostic A/B comparison only using same frozen fixture/DLL/flags, wall-phase markers plus thread/process CPU timing aligned per frame, reporting logic-step count and ordinary quarters. This is localization, not another three-pair acceptance or selective rerun. Do not change optimization paths or broaden tests.
status: Performance regression risk remains unresolved; evidence does not justify main integration on no-regression grounds.
